name: E-Commerce & D2C Brands
description: Handles high volumes of 'Where is my order?' tracking inquiries, return/exchange authorizations, and product sizing questions.

knowledgeBase.title: Shipping & Tracking Policy
knowledgeBase.content: Standard US shipping takes 3-5 business days. Once fulfilled, tracking numbers are automatically sent via email. Orders over $75 ship free.

knowledgeBase.title: Returns & Exchanges
knowledgeBase.content: We offer a 30-day return policy for unworn items with tags attached. Pre-paid return shipping labels are generated automatically in the Returns Portal.

knowledgeBase.title: Damaged or Missing Items
knowledgeBase.content: For items damaged during transit, notify us within 48 hours of delivery with photo proof for an immediate no-cost replacement.

sampleTickets.subject: Where is my order? ORD-84920
sampleTickets.body: Hi, I placed order ORD-84920 4 days ago and haven't received an update. Can you let me know when it will arrive?

sampleTickets.subject: Exchange request for size medium leggings
sampleTickets.body: The leggings from order ORD-99211 are too small. How do I exchange them for a Large?
